name: Hans Mueller
headline: Principal Software Architect
summary: Software architect with 16 years in Java, from Java EE monoliths to event-driven platforms for insurance and logistics. I help teams make architecture decisions they can still live with five years later.

experience.title: Principal Software Architect
bullets: Own the target architecture for claims and policy systems: 60 Spring Boot microservices run by nine teams.
Led the strangler migration off a 15-year-old mainframe integration layer onto Kafka event streams.
Defined the Kubernetes deployment and observability standards adopted across the IT division.
Run the architecture review board and coach senior engineers on domain-driven design in Java.

experience.title: Senior Java Engineer
bullets: Built the shipment-tracking backend in Java 8, later moving its services onto Spring Boot.
Integrated 40 carrier systems through RabbitMQ queues with retry and dead-letter handling.
Mapped the shipment domain with Hibernate and cut the nightly batch from six hours to 90 minutes.
Set up Jenkins pipelines for the department's first automated releases.

experience.title: Java Developer
bullets: Developed Java EE 6 modules for a municipal tax system on JBoss application servers.
Wrote Hibernate mappings and hand-tuned SQL for the property-tax ledger.
Migrated the build from Ant to Maven and added JUnit tests to the core billing rules.
